title: Four-Dimensional Standard-Subspace Nets with Minimal Length
exact_target: Can a natural local quantum-subspace net in four-dimensional Minkowski space have a positive minimum localization length?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002834 (OWR-13673-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Conformal Field Theory (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/16, pp. 849--926. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 8, 9.
Lechner--Longo, localization in standard spaces (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
published localization results (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The word natural and the precise minimal-length condition are not specified in the catalogue extraction. In particular, no particular double-cone radius threshold is invented as the original definition.
